verdict.rationale: All three distribution routes in the story are covered. Plugin marketplaces offer centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates, and git-repo or local sources, and anyone with access can register one with a single command (docs-8, docs-36, docs-71, docs-9, gh-1). Plugins are documented for sharing with teammates (docs-7, docs-21). Project-level skills live in `.claude/skills/` (docs-33), and a hands-on probe installed a skill from the official repo into `./.claude/skills/` (probe-rt-1). API skills can also be kept private to a workspace (docs-12, docs-24). Missing for 10: explicit docs that committing `.claude/skills/` to version control shares skills team-wide, and evidence of admin-enforced or managed skill distribution across a team.
